tools.name: cognitoforms_list_forms
tools.description: List the forms the API key can access, with each form's id and name. Good first call to find a form id. REST: GET /api/forms.

tools.name: cognitoforms_get_form_schema
tools.description: Get a form's schema: field names, types and choices. Use the field names when you create or update entries. REST: GET /api/forms/{formId}/schema.

tools.name: cognitoforms_list_entries
tools.description: List the entries of one form view through the OData service. Set count to get the total, or ids_only to get entry ids only. The vendor OData reference does not list view ids, so pass the id of the view you want. OData: GET /api/odata/Forms({formId})/Views({viewId})/Entries.

tools.name: cognitoforms_get_entry
tools.description: Get one entry with its field values and metadata (links to documents and the admin view). REST: GET /api/forms/{formId}/entries/{entryId}.

tools.name: cognitoforms_get_entry_file
tools.description: Get an uploaded file from an entry: name, type, size and file link. The base64 body comes only when include_content is true. REST: GET /api/forms/{formId}/entries/{entryId}/files/{fileId}.

tools.name: cognitoforms_get_entry_document
tools.description: Get a document generated from an entry by a document template: name, type, size and file link. The base64 body comes only when include_content is true. REST: GET /api/forms/{formId}/entries/{entryId}/documents/{templateId}.

tools.name: cognitoforms_create_entry
tools.description: Submit a new entry to a form with the given field values. The form's notifications, workflows and payments run as they do for a submission. REST: POST /api/forms/{formId}/entries.

tools.name: cognitoforms_update_entry
tools.description: Update the given field values of an existing entry. Fields you leave out keep their values. REST: PATCH /api/forms/{formId}/entries/{entryId}.

tools.name: cognitoforms_delete_entry
tools.description: Permanently delete one entry, with its files and documents. Confirm the entry id first. REST: DELETE /api/forms/{formId}/entries/{entryId}.

tools.name: cognitoforms_set_public_link_availability
tools.description: Set when the form's public link accepts submissions, with an optional message shown while it is closed. Dates use ISO 8601 date-times. REST: POST /api/forms/{formId}/public-link-availability.
